paras: SP Shagidov F.T., hereinafter the ‘Contractor’, represented by General Director Shagidov F.T., acting under the Certificate of State Registration of a Sole Proprietor, enters into this Public Remunerated Services Agreement (the ‘Agreement’) with any individual, hereinafter the ‘Customer’.

The Agreement provides paid access to the Contractor’s service for generating music, images, and songs via Vokalo.kg, Vokalo.ru, Vokalo.online, concluded by public offer, and governs service provision and the Parties’ obligations.
The Contractor publishes the Agreement on the websites Vokalo.kg, Vokalo.ru, Vokalo.online. Guided by Part 2, Article 398 of the Civil Code of the Kyrgyz Republic, the Parties agree as follows.

sections.title: 1. Subject of the Agreement
paras: 1.1. The Contractor provides access to the service for generating music, images, and songs; the Customer pays the fee.
1.2. Access is provided through Vokalo.kg, Vokalo.ru, Vokalo.online.
1.3. Terms:
1.3.1. Website — the websites at Vokalo.kg, Vokalo.ru, Vokalo.online.
1.3.2. Personal Account — protected pages created upon registration and accessible by entering authentication data (email and password).

1.3.3. Invoice — an invoice/bill/price agreement protocol or similar document determining the price and, if needed, the payment procedure. Terms apply equally in singular and plural as the context requires.
1.4. The Customer may use access under this Agreement during the period stated on the Website.
1.5. The Contractor does not provide individual consultations unrelated to the subject matter.

sections.title: 2. Conclusion and Access Provision
paras: 2.1. This is a public agreement under which the Contractor provides services to an indefinite number of persons (Customers).
2.2. Publishing the text on the Website constitutes a public offer to conclude the Agreement (Art. 386(1), 398(2) Civil Code of KR).
2.3. The Agreement is concluded by adhesion — acceptance of all terms without reservations (Art. 387 Civil Code of KR).

2.4. Acceptance is the Customer’s payment for the services under this Agreement. If paid with bank credit funds, acceptance is the Customer entering into a credit agreement with the bank to pay for the Contractor’s services (Art. 399(3) Civil Code of KR).
2.5. By accepting, the Customer agrees to all terms; under Art. 395(2)(3) and 399(3) of the Civil Code of KR, the Agreement is deemed concluded in writing.
2.6. After acceptance, the Contractor provides access to the service.

sections.title: 3. Rights and Obligations
paras: 3.1. The Contractor shall:
3.1.1. Provide access to the service for generating music, images, and songs.
3.1.2. Provide information support on business days 09:00–18:00 (until 17:00 on Fridays/short days). Support requests: {{email}}.
3.1.3. Fix its own errors/defects at its own expense.
3.1.4. Issue refunds in the cases and under the conditions of the Agreement.
3.2. The Contractor may:
3.2.1. Modify the service.
3.2.2. Engage third parties without the Customer’s approval.
3.2.3. Request information/documents necessary to perform obligations.
3.2.4. Change prices and publish current prices on the Website.
3.2.5. Temporarily suspend the Website for maintenance and repairs.
3.2.6. Replace engaged third parties.
3.3. The Customer shall:
3.3.1. Pay for services within the terms set by the Agreement/Invoices/Personal Account messages.
3.3.2. Provide complete and accurate information (including during registration).
3.3.3. Use the Website and access solely for personal/non‑commercial purposes.
3.3.4. Keep Personal Account credentials confidential and not share them.
3.3.5. Immediately notify the Contractor of unauthorized access to the Personal Account.
3.3.6. Not post or attempt to obtain others’ personal data.
3.3.7. Not register on behalf of/for another person, a group, or a legal entity/SP.
3.3.8. Not disrupt the Website or use malware/automation without written permission.
3.4. The Customer may:
3.4.1. Obtain access after meeting the access conditions (Section 2).
3.4.2. Receive information support during the Agreement term.
3.4.3. Use access only for non‑commercial purposes.
3.4.4. Send comments, suggestions, and feedback.

sections.title: 4. Fees and Payment
paras: 4.1. Fees are as stated on the Website or in the Invoice, in Kyrgyz som.
4.2. Payment: 100% prepayment in a single transfer to the Contractor’s account unless otherwise stated in the Invoice. Payment date is the date funds are credited to the Contractor’s account.
4.3. Payment methods are those supported by the Contractor; current methods are on the Website or provided otherwise. Detailed rules are in Appendix No. 1.

4.4. The Customer may pay using bank credit funds provided by a bank. This Agreement is not a credit agreement; the Contractor is not a lender; credit terms, interest, and refusals are the bank’s responsibility.
4.5. The service/goods are deemed provided on the date of provision.

sections.title: 5. Liability and Limitations
paras: 5.1. For violations, the Customer shall pay a penalty of 5000 KGS per violation upon the Contractor’s written demand (out‑of‑court).

5.2. Upon violation, the Contractor may deactivate the Personal Account and block Website access without refund. The Customer shall pay default interest within 15 calendar days from receipt of the Contractor’s claim/notice.

5.3. The Contractor is not liable for: content in user chats (WhatsApp, Viber, Telegram); use of personal data shared by the Customer in such chats; Internet connectivity/equipment/software of the Customer; non‑compliance of the Customer’s equipment with requirements; services not meeting expectations (subjective opinion is not a quality criterion); the Customer’s errors when using the Website; the choice/use of payment method and its consequences; actions/omissions of banks or third parties in payments/refunds.

5.4. The Contractor does not guarantee uninterrupted Website operation and does not compensate losses due to ISP failures, Internet access restrictions, loss of Personal Account access caused by the Customer, or other circumstances beyond the Contractor’s control.
5.5. Force majeure: fire, flood, earthquake and other natural disasters, strikes, wars, epidemics, pandemics, and other circumstances beyond the Parties’ control.

5.6. If the Customer fails to perform (including under cl. 4.2), the Contractor may unilaterally terminate out of court by emailing a notice to the address previously used for access. The Agreement terminates on the sending date or the date stated; access is deactivated.

sections.title: 6. Intellectual Property and Confidentiality
paras: 6.1. Access is provided to the Contractor’s/third parties’ IP (software, audiovisual materials, LMS, guides, reference materials, assignments, information resources).

6.2. The Customer shall not infringe IP rights; shall not copy/record/reproduce/replicate/distribute/modify/create derivatives without the Contractor’s written permission; shall promptly report infringements; shall not share credentials; in case of loss/unauthorized access — immediately notify {{email}}; until notification, all actions are deemed performed by the Customer.
6.3. Confidential information means any service‑related information not publicly available. The Customer shall not disclose such information without the Contractor’s written consent.
6.4. The Contractor may use objects created by the Customer while studying materials in its marketing/advertising and may mention the Customer as a user/client.

sections.title: 7. Other Terms
paras: 7.1. The Customer confirms legal capacity and that they meet the age requirements under KR law for transactions via the Website.
7.2. Service may be refused if: the bank/payment system does not confirm payment authorization; a refund is initiated; other cases provided by KR law or the Agreement.

sections.title: 8. Final Provisions
paras: 8.1. The Agreement is concluded upon actions under cl. 2.4 and remains effective until obligations are fulfilled.
8.2. The Contractor may amend the terms and add new terms/appendices without prior notice. Continued use of the service/Website constitutes consent.
8.3. Amendments/new versions are published on the Website.
8.4. Silence (no written objections, including on tariffs) constitutes consent and accession to the new version.
8.5. The Agreement may be terminated by mutual consent. Either Party may unilaterally withdraw by notifying the other via Personal Account or email at least 15 calendar days before termination.
8.6. Invalidity of any provision does not invalidate the remainder.
8.7. KR law governs matters not regulated herein.

8.8. Disputes: negotiations; if unresolved — courts of the Kyrgyz Republic with mandatory pre‑trial procedure (claim identifying the sender and delivery; returned mail due to absence of recipient does not prevent filing; response — 10 business days; lack of response — consent).
8.9. The Parties recognize the legal force of documents sent via electronic means or the Personal Account.
8.10. The Customer consents to personal data processing under the Website’s Privacy Policy.

8.11. The Customer consents to the Contractor’s use of reviews without full name and image, with adaptations not distorting meaning, for websites, social media, mailings, and other materials. Consent is valid from conclusion and can be withdrawn by written request to the Contractor’s address.
8.12. The Customer consents to receive advertising and informational messages (email, phone, Viber/Telegram/WhatsApp, postal mail, SMS, push, calls).

sections.title: 9. Details
paras: 9.1. Customer details are those provided during registration/application/payment.
9.2. Contractor details:

appendix.title: Appendix No. 1 — Payment and Refund Rules
paras: These Rules govern payment for services under the Agreement and refunds upon early termination.
1. Final price per selected plan/service. Non‑cash payment via Website methods by crediting the Contractor’s account.

2. Accepted: VISA, MasterCard, ELKART, and e‑wallets. Payments follow Visa/MasterCard rules with confidentiality and security (checks, encryption, secure channels). For PSP rules, refer to respective PSPs. The Contractor may provide informational support without obligation or liability for the payment method/PSP chosen.
3. To pay by bank card, choose ‘Pay by bank card’ and click ‘Pay’.
4. Payment is made on a secure PSP/bank page using 3‑D Secure. Enter card number, cardholder name, expiry date, CVV2/CVC2. A special password (MasterCard SecureCode/Verified by Visa) may be required.
5. Card details are not stored on the Contractor’s server/Website; confidentiality is ensured by the PSP/bank. Disclosure to third parties only as required by KR law.
6. Payment may be refused if: the card is not enabled for internet payments; insufficient funds; incorrect details; card expired.
7. The Contractor does not control the PSP/bank. If funds are debited due to errors without PSP/bank authorization, the PSP/bank performs the refund.

8. Refunds are possible if: 8.1 the service/goods were not provided on time due to the Contractor’s fault; 8.2 the Customer notified termination and refund before service commencement; 8.3 other cases per cl. 14 of these Rules.

9. Refunds are made upon a written request to {{email}} with subsequent sending of the original to: Kyrgyz Republic, Bishkek, Usenbaeva St. 138a, apt. 6. The Contractor may require a prescribed request form.
10. If the Customer withdraws before service/goods are provided (other than credit payments) — 100% refund.
11. For credit payments — refund to the bank less fees retained by the bank from the Contractor; the Customer’s loan interest is not reimbursed.
12. If the Customer withdraws within 30 calendar days from service/goods provision — 50% refund. For credit — refund to the bank minus fees; interest is not reimbursed.
13. Clarification: for ‘credit’ purchases, amounts/expenses are calculated from the amount actually received by the Contractor from the bank.
14. If the Customer withdraws after 30 calendar days from provision — no refund.
15. Refund timing: to the original payment account within up to 30 days from receipt (timing depends on the issuing bank).
16. If payment details changed or payment was by credit funds, the Customer must provide current bank details for the refund; otherwise, the Contractor is not liable for incorrect/late refund.
